RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the May 10, 2006/Vaisakha 20, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Bomb blasts in Jammu and
Kashmir
*361. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Srinagar (Jammu and
Kashmir) experienced serial bomb blasts
on the 14th April, 2006;
(b) if so, the number of persons who
died and those who were seriously injured
as a result thereof;
(c) the number out of them who were
civilians, para-military/army personnel and
the terrorists involved, separately;
(d) the terrorist organizations
responsible for these blasts;
(e) the number of terrorists responsible
for the blasts  apprehended so far; and
(f) the  follow up action taken to avoid
such incidents?
Funds received by NGOs
*362. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) how many Non-Governmental
Organizations (NGOs) under his Ministry
are in receipt of the Central funds;
(b) whether  these NGOs are regularly
submitting  the required utilization
certificates; and
(c) if not, what action Government are
contemplating to take against the defaulting
NGOs during 2005-06, till date, NGO-
wise?
Export of iron-ore
†*363. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a)  the companies that have been given
approval for export of iron-ore;
(b) the quantum of iron-ore exported
so far by these companies; and
(c)  whether any import of iron-ore is
also being made  and if so, the details
thereof?
Export of Virginia  tobacco
*364. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the export targets  of Virginia tobacco
for  2006-07;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

114
(b) the quantity of tobacco expected to
be exported in 2006-07;
(c) what financial  and commercial
incentives Government propose to give for
such Virginia tobacco exports in the
forthcoming year; and
(d) the steps proposed  to assist Andhra
Pradesh farmers in this regard?
Establishment of Disaster
Management Commissions
*365. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the State Governments which have
not  yet established the State Disaster
Management Commissions;
(b) the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of the disasters  that have
taken place in different  States, natural  or
man-made, after formation of the Central
and State Disaster Management
Commissions?
Pledge of BIMSTEC countries on
terrorism
*366. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that Bay of
Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral
Technical and Economic Cooperation
BIMSTEC  countries pledged not to allow
use of their territories by terrorist groups
for launching attacks on friendly
Governments and agreed to share
information and cooperate in capacity
building;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(c) what action has  so far been taken in
pursuance of the above decisions?
Funds to States under ASIDE
*367. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY   be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  Government have allocated
funds to  State Governments for creating
infrastructure for development  and growth
of exports under ASIDE Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof  during the
last three years, year-wise and State-wise;
(c) whether assistance  is extended only
for export of goods and not services;
(d) if so, the reasons  therefor;
(e) whether  Karnataka  Government
has requested for extending  assistance to
export of IT and related  services, since 50
per cent of its exports relates  to this sector;
and
(f) if so, the details  thereof and
Government's  reaction thereto?
Agreements and MoUs with various
countries
*368. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY   be pleased to state:
(a) the countries  visited by him during
2005-06, till date;
(b) the details  of the agreements and
MoUs  entered into with various countries
during  the above period;
(c) whether  enough safeguards have
been  provided to take  care of the domestic
industries;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

115
Funds under PMGSY to Punjab
*369. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government had released
the funds in full to the State Government
of Punjab under Prime Minister's Gram
Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) during the years
2000 to 2004;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor and the
total amount still to be released to clear the
backlog; and
(c) by when the backlog is likely to be
cleared?
Reports on SMEs by NMCC

Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the May 10, 2006/Vaisakha 20, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —155
Amendments in Foreign Trade
Policy 2004-09
2556. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced several amendments in the
Foreign Trade Policy 2004-2009;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the benefits to accrue to different
segments of the economy?
Marine exports
2557. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any effort has been made
to expand the scope of marine exports from
the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that MPEDA
has not been able to go beyond traditional
exports for the last two decades;
(c) what plans and steps does MPEDA
have to increase value-added exports from
the country; and
(d) the details of the steps taken by
MPEDA to arrange inspection facilities for
new marine exports and value-added
exports from the country?
Growth of exports
2558. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the anticipated growth rate
of exports during 2006-07;
(b) the share of IT, Services, traditional
items, Manufacturing Sector, etc. in
exports; and
(c) the share of agriculture-based
products during 2004-05 and how much
growth was there in the first nine months
of 2005-06?
Benefits of Vishesh Krishi and Gram
Udyog Yojana to EOUs under SEZs
2559. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether EOU and units in Special

576
Economic Zones will not qualify for benefit
under the Vishesh Krishi and Gram Udyog
Yojana;
(b) if so, the reason therefor; and
(c) how Government propose to
compensate those units?
Share of EPZs/SEZs in
exports
2560. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the share of Export
Processing Zones/Special Economic Zones
in the country's overall export performance
during last three years; and
(b) how many Export Processing Zones/
Special Economic Zones are in operation
in the country as on date?
Deliberations at World Economic
Forum, Davos
2561. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a high power
delegation recently participated at the
meetings of the World Economic Forum at
Davos;
(b) the issues relevant to the country
deliberated at the Conference; and
(c) the details of the conclusions arrived
at having an impact on the country's
economy?
Conflict diamond
2562. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry differed with
the Ministry of Mines on the issue of
conflict diamond;
(b) if so, whether the issue has been
sorted out;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Intellectual Property Rights Appellate
Tribunal
2563. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Intellectual Property
Rights Appellate Tribunal to adjudicate
disputes under the TRIPS has been set up;
(b) if so, the details of the disputes that
it has so far adjudicated since its
constitution in September, 2003, year-wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the post
of Vice-Chairman is lying vacant since long;
and
(d) if so, the reasons for not filling-up
of the vacancy?
Growth rate of manufacturing sector
in exports
2564. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the growth
rate of imports has increased more than
exports during the financial year 2005-06;

577
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, Government's response thereto
and whether it is a fact that the
manufacturing sector is slowly losing while
the service sector is gaining ground in India;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of steps taken by
Government for improving growth rate of
manufacturing sector in the country?
Sale of tobacco products to minors
2565. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the ‘‘Tobacco Products (Prohibition of
Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and
Commerce, Production, Supply and
Distribution) Act, 2003’’ is more observed
in its breach than compliance;
(b) if so, whether action has been
initiated against publishing houses and
vendors and cigarette companies for
violation of this act;
(c) the number of cases registered and
action taken thereof, since inception of this
act;
(d) whether tobacco products are sold
to minors and students at schools with
impunity; and
(e) if so, the action taken thereon?
